properties.name: bab_el_mandeb_core
properties.description: Red Sea event AOI: the Bab el-Mandeb strait itself plus the immediate southern Red Sea approach, the chokepoint every Red Sea transit must pass.
properties.navigation_rationale: The strait is the single narrow transit point of the southern Red Sea; traffic rerouted around the Cape of Good Hope never passes it. Chosen from the navigation chart, not from matching-rate results.
properties.caveat: The box is ~60 x 72 km, smaller than one Sentinel-1 IW scene, so coverage fraction should be high.
